reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Helm option `enableCiliumEndpointSlice` has been deprecated and will be removed in a future release", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: deprecation

consequence.statement: The enableCiliumEndpointSlice Helm option is deprecated and will be removed in a future release; existing deployments using this option should migrate to ciliumEndpointSlice.enabled.
consequence.remediation: Update Helm values to replace enableCiliumEndpointSlice with ciliumEndpointSlice.enabled.

proposed.statement: Helm option enableCiliumEndpointSlice has been deprecated and will be removed in a future release; use ciliumEndpointSlice.enabled instead.
